SummonerBarrier_Jade.name: Barrier
SummonerBarrier_Jade.description: Gain a short duration shield. Summoner's Resolve: Barrier's Shield is increased.
SummonerBarrier_Jade.tooltip: Gain a {{ shieldstrengthfinal }} damage Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

SummonerBattleCry_Jade.name: Surge
SummonerBattleCry_Jade.description: Temporarily empowers your champion, granting Attack Speed  and Ability Power for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: Increases the Attack Speed bonus by 5% and the Ability Power bonus by 10%.
SummonerBattleCry_Jade.tooltip: Empowers your champion, granting {{ totalasactual }} Attack Speed and {{ totalapactual }} Ability Power for 12 seconds.

SummonerBoost_Jade.name: Cleanse
SummonerBoost_Jade.description: Removes all disables and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and temporarily lowers the duration of incoming disables. Summoner's Resolve: Extends the Tenacity buff duration.
SummonerBoost_Jade.tooltip: Removes all disables and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and reduces the duration of disables by 65% for the next {{ tenacitydurationfinalcalc }} seconds.

SummonerClairvoyance_Jade.name: Clairvoyance
SummonerClairvoyance_Jade.description: Reveals a small area of the map for your team for a short duration. Summoner's Insight: Retain sight on units revealed by Clairvoyance for 5 seconds.
SummonerClairvoyance_Jade.tooltip: Reveals a small area of the map for your team for 5 seconds.

SummonerDot_Jade.name: Ignite
SummonerDot_Jade.description: Deals true damage over time to target enemy champion and reduces healing effects on them for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: While Ignite is on cooldown, gain 5 Ability Power and Attack Damage.
SummonerDot_Jade.tooltip:
Deals {{ tooltiptruedamagecalculation }} true damage to target enemy champion over 5 seconds and applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for the duration.

Wounds: Reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.

SummonerExhaust_Jade.name: Exhaust
SummonerExhaust_Jade.description: Slows target enemy champion and reduces their Attack Speed and damage dealt. Summoner's Wrath: Exhaust also reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist by 10.
SummonerExhaust_Jade.tooltip: Exhausts target enemy champion, reducing their Movement Speed and Damage dealt by {{ damagereduction }}% for 2.5 seconds and reducing their Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedreduction }}% for the duration.

SummonerFlash_Jade.name: Flash
SummonerFlash_Jade.description: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor. Summoner's Insight: Reduces Flash's Cooldown by 15 seconds.
SummonerFlash_Jade.tooltip: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor.

SummonerFortify_Jade.name: Fortify
SummonerFortify_Jade.description: Grants invulnerability to all Allied Turrets and causes them to attack 100% faster for 6 seconds. Summoner's Resolve: Turrets deal splash damage around their target.
SummonerFortify_Jade.tooltip:
Passive: While Fortify is off cooldown, deal {{ bonusminiondamage }} bonus damage to minions on-hit.

Active: Grants invulnerability to all Allied Turrets and causes them to attack {{ attackspeed*100 }}% faster for {{ duration }} seconds.

SummonerHaste_Jade.name: Ghost
SummonerHaste_Jade.description: Gain Move Speed and ignore unit collision for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: Bonus Move Speed granted by Ghost is increased.
SummonerHaste_Jade.tooltip:
Gain {{ movespeedmodfinal }} Move Speed and become Ghosted for {{ duration }} seconds.

Ghost: Ignore collision with other units.

SummonerHeal_Jade.name: Heal
SummonerHeal_Jade.description: Restores Health to your champion and to nearby allies. Summoner's Resolve: Gain 5 Health per level.
SummonerHeal_Jade.tooltip: Restores {{ totalheal }} Health to your champion and nearby allies.

SummonerMana_Jade.name: Clarity
SummonerMana_Jade.description: Restores your and ally champions' Mana. Summoner's Insight: Restores more mana.
SummonerMana_Jade.tooltip: Restores {{ selfmanaactual }} Mana to your Champion and {{ allymanaactual }} max Mana to nearby allies.

SummonerRally_Jade.name: Rally
SummonerRally_Jade.description: Summons a temporary beacon which increases allied Attack damage in an area. Summoner's Wrath: Rally additionally gives Ability Power.
SummonerRally_Jade.tooltip: Summons a beacon with {{ hpcalc }} Health for 15 seconds which creates an aura that increases allied Attack damage by {{ adcalc }}.

SummonerRevive_Jade.name: Revive
SummonerRevive_Jade.description: Instantly revives your champion at your team's Summoner Platform and increases their Movement Speed for a short duration. Summoner's Insight: Revive temporarily grants the user 220-560 Health.
SummonerRevive_Jade.tooltip: Instantly revives your champion at your team's Summoner Platform and grants +{{ spell.summonerrevive_jade:bonusmovespeed*100 }}% Movement Speed that decays over 12 seconds.

SummonerSmite_Jade.name: Smite
SummonerSmite_Jade.description: Deals true damage to target enemy minion or pet. Summoner's Resolve: Smite grants 10 gold per cast.
SummonerSmite_Jade.tooltip: Deals {{ smitedamage }} true damage to target enemy minion or pet.

SummonerSpell_Promote_Jade.name: Promote
SummonerSpell_Promote_Jade.description: Promotes a minion, granting it bonus stats, an empowering aura, and causing it to grant the caster gold for its kills. Summoner's Wrath: The Siege Rider's bonus Attack Damage aura also affects Champions.
SummonerSpell_Promote_Jade.tooltip:
Promotes an allied minion to a Siege Rider with {{ unithealth }} Health and {{ unitdamage }} Attack Damage who grants the caster gold for its kills.

The Siege Rider has an aura that provides {{ damageaura }} Attack Damage and {{ armoraura }} Armor to nearby minions.

SummonerTeleport_Jade.name: Teleport
SummonerTeleport_Jade.description: After a short channel, your champion teleports to a target allied minion, turret, or ward. Summoner's Insight: Teleport's channel time is reduced.
SummonerTeleport_Jade.tooltip: After channeling for {{ channeltimefinal }} seconds, your champion teleports to target allied minion, turret, or ward.
